title: styphelia flavescens
intro: Styphelia flavescens, commonly known as mountain pepper, is a shrub native to Tasmania. It has been used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory actions, which can aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Styphelia flavescens also include its antioxidant and antiviral properties, making it potentially useful in the treatment of various infections and diseases. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
